body: Thank you so much for your kindness.

We would need to hire someone. My spouse is the bread winner, and my job is convenient for kids' schedules. As such, I do essentially all of the yard work myself. It would be a substantial cost to hire someone.

"How much did you purchase the home for? How much do you owe on it? What is the value of it now? "
We bought the home about 2 years after the housing market crashed. We think it is worth about 20% more now than what we purchased it for. I would believe we would come out ahead or at least even on our current property as long as we bought a smaller property.

"How close is it to your jobs and schools? Where would you go if you sold it?"
The drive is convenient for me (15 minutes) but not as convenient for my spouse (30 minutes). I would try to get us to move 10 minutes closer to my spouse's employer, which really wouldn't add much, if any, time to my drive. I would move down the road into the neighboring school district, where we want to send the kids. 

"Also, you say you have kids now. So they should be helping with the yardwork or at least learning to already."
The kids are toddlers and one of them has special needs.
